textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Gimme Catalyst or I'm stealing your bones.            I didn’t make the rules.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I also really enjoy the Watcher,        but thinking about it;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Every character is uniquely different          and really fun to play,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And I think that speaks for how well this game is designed.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I highly recommend it,       and I cannot wait to touch part 2.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Until laterrrr~~

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: An edgelord prosecutor,          In old england,          An intriguing and connected story,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: With an amazing ost          and Herlock -fucking Sholmes?!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Yeah no,        The Great Ace Attorney just has exactly what I want.          I love it so much..

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: It’s technically 2 separate games           but one big story,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: So if you don’t play both            you're probably committing a cardinal sin.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: This Story's pacing is damn near perfection.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: They manage to set up,          and loop back         every         single         thread they made,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And left practically no loose ends.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Even the      -usually      weak cases         are somehow connected to the bigger picture.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And some of these cases just           go off the rails in terms of lore significance.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I was practically glued to each one of them.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: AND HOW COULD I NOT BE!?

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: This games characters are so endearing and charming,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: You cannot help but be dragged into it all.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Lemme reiterate;         They got someone called     Herlock           -fucking           Sholmes.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And it works.           It’s not out of place,           it fits perfectly in character         and somehow;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: You still take this absolute lunatic of a character seriously when you have to.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: In addition to that,           Ace attorney ost’s have never let me down;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And this one just          picked me up,              cradled me,            gave me a kiss       and packed my lunch for me.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I         have rarely felt so good and satisfied after a game's ending.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I am still baffled by it.           It’s just peak.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: But that's not even CLOSE to describing how great this game is!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: It’s INEFFABLE!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I'm way over time..            But I wanna yap more..

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: PLAY THE GAME!           IT'S SO GOOD!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Stardew Valley is such a chill game~

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Unless you played factorio before          and are a minmaxer;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Then you are stressing to optimize the day as much as you can.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: If ur not going to bed one swing away from passing out,             value lost.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Relationships?            More like,       I need to spend the entire day watering my farm!

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Half jokes aside,          It is very cozy.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And I think           most people don’t attempt to finish the community center in the first year.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And If I treat my second year,           how others probably play their first,           it is indeed cozy.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: This game also has a really great modding community;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And it’s full of super cool and sweet things!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I’m talking;          Mods with more hair varietyyyy        and that It doesn't clip,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Pretty clohes,           More decoration,             Expansion mods,           Npc mods           and even;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Automation.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Very precious stuff!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And I think when played with a friend,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: This game would shine         as it seems like the perfect co-op game!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Maybe I could convince the Nexus to play with me..

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Or Cagli....

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Or a duplicate of myself........

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmm...

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: V-Rising is a delightful game         that hits the vampire fantasy on the spot.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: It’s progress is very akin to Terraria,        in the sense of;

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Build a base,          get resources,           fight a boss to unlock progression,         upgrade base,         repeat.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Its combat is also really smooth,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And with multiple different weapons and spells to adjust your style;

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: You can become all powerful!

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And honestly what more do you want from a Vampire fantasy?

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Sit in your self built castle,         Seduce people into becoming your servants,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Looking for the purest of blood quality,           Avoiding the sun.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Turn into a rat.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: At least I think that's what vampires do..

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Why would they not,          rat strats are very powerful.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I would know.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Oh,          and before I forget.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Not only does this game keep getting updated and better,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: But it also has a really nice ”hard mode”,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: With added boss abilities and such!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I would very much recommend it         if you like the progression of Terraria,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: The combat of Hades              or just the Vampire aesthetic in general!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: See u laterr~

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And once again         a small n sweet game has captured the equivalent of my heart.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Crypt of the NecroDancer is put plainly,           a perfect encapsulated bit of joy.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: A rhythmmmm                   dungeon crawler?            Rogue-like?

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Not sure,          but precious nonetheless.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: For how short and simple the game is,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: It takes quite a bit of learning         before you get the hang of it.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: There isn't really time to think when you have to move in a beat.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: All you got is pattern memorisation,            general instinct,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And the rhythm in your bones.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Also,         I don’t need to mention this          but I'll do it anyway;

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: The rhythm game indeed has great music.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And I am not ashamed to admit;             I have died on bosses,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Because I was grooving too hard to the track.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I also haven’t beaten the game with theeee           half heart character yet,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: A slime can only do so many things at once..

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And the tie to your world seems to have an impact on Chronos..

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Eh,         I’m sure that will not cause any critical or lasting consequences.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Cya.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: OMG Esquie,       mon ami!     Hiiiiii!

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: I swear        if this game wasn’t peak,          this would be an Esquie video.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And I'm           THIS    close           from making it one regardless.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: But alas;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33,       is a masterful game          that excels in nearly every aspect.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: An intriguing and beautiful world / story,             A satisfying and expansive combat,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: A delightful cast of characters,          A phenomenal soundtrack,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: And the existence of Esquie.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Every character plays differently         and it's really cool to craft a build for everyone.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: There are so many different forms of Pictos,           that I had to self ban a few of them,

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Because my Maelle turned into a continental nuke.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And as cool as it is to obliterate every enemy or boss indiscriminately;

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I would like to actually fight them.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And that also means         more time spent listening to impeccable battle music!

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And,       Oh     my       realm tree.          Monoco’s track.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: All I’m saying;           If I had actual pants,           I would no longer have them.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Anyway,          here are my top 3 favorite characters;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: 3rd place:          Esquie

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: 2nd place:          Esquie with a headband

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: 1st place:          Esquie offering a hug

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Ty for reading.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Au revoir,    mon amiiiiii~

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I love the artstyle of this game soooo muchhhh!

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Cult of the Lamb is a pure treat        to anyone that likes chill base building,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Mixed with a lil rogue-like to spice things up.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And this game balances that delightfully well.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: The beautifully precious OST           along with the style of the game          really make this one shine!

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And I gotta say,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: There is something charmingly odd and surreal         about seeing a bunch of adorable animals,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Doing all kinds of deranged cult things.

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Now       given,              I made them do it            {bold}BUT{/bold}

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: They shan't worry;

textBox.name: Lyzzy
textBox.text: Because not even death      can excuse them from service,     in my cult.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Death is temporary,           Slime is eternal.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: That said,           Go play the game.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: It’s short n sweet,

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: And I really cannot describe this game's charm in mere words.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: Also you play as a lamb.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: I like lambs.

textBox.name: Lyz
textBox.text: That’s it.         Shooo.            Come back after you finish it.
